newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Financial says no offer made for it.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Financial says no offer made for it.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said Wednesday that no definitive offers to acquire the company have been made.
It said that, as was announced on August 26, a party had indicated interest in buying the company, but neither that party nor certain other interested parties have made a definitive offer.
The company said it will continue to examine strategic alternatives available to it, assisted by its financial adviser Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.
It said no assurance can be given that it will receive any acceptable takeover proposals.
Olympic Financial said any proposal would be evaluated in light of market conditions. It said no specific price range or deal terms have been set by its board.
The company said its third quarter earnings are expected to meet analysts' expectations. It did not indicate what those expectations are.
The company was not available for further comment.
According to First Call, the mean analyst estimate for the third quarter is $0.42, with a range of $0.40 to $0.44, compared with year-ago earnings of $0.30.
